entries.heading: Verse 1
entries.text: Ps 67:1-7 . A prayer that, by God's blessing on His people, His salvation and praise may be extended over the earth.

entries.heading: 2. thy way
entries.text: 2. thy way --of gracious dealing ( Isa 55:8 ), as explained by-- saving health --or literally, "salvation."
3-5. Thanks will be rendered for the blessings of His wise and holy government (compare Isa 2:3, 4; 11:4 ).
6, 7. The blessings of a fruitful harvest are mentioned as types of greater and spiritual blessings, under which all nations shall fear and love God.
